signal: Reggora raised $18M led by Centana in Feb 2026, acquired virtual-inspection firm Appreeze, and is rolling out a 24-hour appraisal product

email.subject1: a signal play for Reggora's partners
email.body1:
AJ, saw Reggora closed the $18M round, acquired Appreeze, and is launching the 24-hour appraisal product.

Moves like that usually open more co-sell and partner-sourced pipeline than the team can cover by hand. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up across a partner ecosystem on its own, so partner coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Reggora's partner ecosystem off hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
AJ, quick follow-up for Reggora.

Post-raise and post-acquisition, partner-sourced pipeline expectations usually climb faster than the BD team can cover. Co-sell motions stall when nobody has time to research and write to each partner's top accounts at scale.

I had our AI SDR draft three personalized emails to a few of Reggora's top partner targets. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through them and how the motion runs hands-off?
email.body3:
AJ, last bit of proof for Reggora.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Reggora's partner reply rate likely compares to other mortgage-tech teams. Want to grab time so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
AJ, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling partner-sourced pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Timing matters, and right after a raise and an acquisition the team is usually focused on integration.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page co-sell pilot playbook scoped to Reggora's partner ecosystem? I will tailor it either way.
